These notes cover upgrading a Unity Catalog server and its clients from
**{release}** to the next release: the steps to take before you upgrade, and
the calls, settings, and privileges that behave differently afterward. Each
entry links the upstream change it comes from. For everything in a release,
see the [upstream releases](https://github.com/{upstream}/releases).
